Issue asks to document the tuple return in the docstring and HISTORY; test requires Client.list_spreadsheet_files to return a list again, a design the issue only implies (U2).
Patch applies factors during substitution only when the target env is not a default factor, so [testenv:py27] still gets raw 'coverage: coverage'; run hit the 100-turn limit (M3).

Hang comes from find_root_task caching the finished first run_until_complete task; patch only skips idle workers whose loop is closed, which never happens between run_until_complete calls (M2).
Issue allows removal in CanonicalizeModifications or in a separate processor; agent built a separate RemoveUnknownAtoms processor, and the test runs only CanonicalizeModifications (U2).
Patch ORs the file-type bits into external_attr unshifted, so the mode reads '?r-x------', and bare ZipInfo(name) resets member dates to 1980 where writestr(str) used now (M3, M4).
Issue asks only that the comment appear in info; test requires the raw bytes with the trailing NUL, while the agent stores a NUL-stripped latin-1 str (U1).
Issue title says release v0.5.9 but the body says bump versions 0.5.7 to 0.5.8; files already read 0.5.8, so the agent left them, and the test wants 0.5.9 (U4).
Issue states Image.ID must not grow on repeated register_open; patch moves readers to OPEN but register_open still appends, so len(Image.ID) grows (M5).

Patch calls click.edit(..., filename='temp.rst'), which edits a named file and ignores the initial text, instead of click's extension= option; agent rewrote the old tests to expect its call (M5).
